name: Cut In Wall at Trim Edges
intent: Wall painter establishes the wall-to-trim brush line along every painted trim substrate that abuts a painted wall. Same brush technique regardless of whether the wall field is sprayed + backrolled, sprayed only, or brushed + rolled. Fires once per coat per substrate.
doctrine: Cut-in to trim is a brush task independent of the wall field method. Track A 2026-05-02: split single TSK_CUTIN_WALL_TO_TRIM (lumped baseboard+door_casing+window_casing LF only) into 11 per-substrate tasks reading PS_EDGE_LF.CUTIN_WALL_TO_<SUBSTRATE>. Each substrate emits 0 LF unless walls AND that substrate are painted, so inactive substrates contribute 0 hours. This isolation enables (a) per-substrate height-band override (Track B — crown at vaulted ceiling, picture rail at 10ft, etc.), and (b) future per-substrate opt-out flags. Coat 1 baseline 120 LF/hr; coat 2 runs 25% faster (150 LF/hr effective). Excludes shoe_mold (sits on baseboard, not wall-adjacent) and door_frames (inside opening).
